Participez à notre mission ! En tant que leader mondial dans la création de solutions climatiques confortables, durables et efficaces pour les bâtiments, les habitations et les transports, il est de notre responsabilité de placer la planète au premier plan. Pour nous, chezTrane Technologies, et à travers nos activités, y comprisTrane®etThermo KingLa durabilité n’est pas simplement une façon de faire des affaires—c’est au cœur de notre activité. Osez-vous regarder les défis mondiaux et y voir des opportunités porteuses d’impact ? Souhaitez-vous contribuer à bâtir un avenir meilleur ? Si la réponse est oui, nous vous invitons à envisager de nous rejoindre pour repousser les limites du possible en faveur d’un monde durable.

Découvrez nosavantagesconçu pour vous permettre de vous épanouir au travail comme à la maison.

Nous avançons avec audace.

**Où se trouve le travail :**

Du lundi au jeudi, travaillez sur site avec vos collègues. Le vendredi, choisissez votre lieu de travail, en tenant compte des exigences de votre activité.  

**Associate Engineering Manager – Engineering Design**

At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.

**What’s in it for you:**

Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as an **Associate Engineering Manager - Engineering Design**. In this pivotal role, you will facilitate the design and manufacturing of our current & next line of exciting products. As a Associate Engineering Manager – Engineering Design, you will collaborate closely with the design & cross-functional teams globally to build industry-relevant products that meet required specifications for our global customers. The projects could be in the areas of Productivity, New product development, Quality and reliability, Agile, New technology platform and others.

**Thrive at work and at home:**

* Inclusive Wellbeing Program, with resources to support your and your family’s physical, social, emotional, and financial well-being.

* Comprehensive learning and development solutions, designed to support our people in connecting and growing, including Higher education/Certification reimbursement.

* Sense of belonging & community through our Employee Resource Groups that foster our culture of inclusion.

* Volunteerism: 8 hours of paid time off per calendar year to volunteer with non-profit charitable organizations.

* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to support employees facing financial challenges due to unforeseen personal hardship.
  

**Where is the work:**
  
This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule (4 or more days onsite per week) based out of Bangalore.

  

**What you will do:**

* **Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team:** You will inspire, mentor, and lead a talented team of mechanical design engineers. Your primary focus will be on fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative environment where team members can thrive. You will manage the full talent lifecycle, including setting clear objectives, conducting performance reviews, and creating robust development and growth plans for every engineer.
* **Drive Project Execution & Excellence:** You will be accountable for the team's successful delivery of engineering projects, ensuring they meet critical milestones for quality, on-time delivery, and cost. This includes leading rigorous design reviews, providing expert technical guidance, and ensuring all deliverables are of the highest quality and ready for manufacturing.
* **Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Serve as a key technical partner to other departments. You will collaborate closely with leaders in Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations to resolve technical challenges, streamline processes, and ensure seamless integration throughout the product lifecycle.
* **Advance Engineering Capabilities:** You will stay at the forefront of engineering tools and methodologies, driving the adoption of best practices within your team. This includes championing process improvements, overseeing the use of CAD and PLM systems, and identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies to boost productivity and innovation.
* **Contribute to Strategic Vision:** You will play a key role in shaping the future of our engineering function. By managing resources, aligning team priorities with business goals, and contributing to the technology roadmap, you will help ensure our design capabilities remain best-in-class.

  

**What you will bring:**

* **Leadership & Experience:** A mechanical engineering background with 13+ years of progressive industry experience, including at least 5 years in a direct people management role.

* **Core Engineering Design:** Extensive hands-on experience in mechanical design, with demonstrated success in New Product Development (NPD), VAVE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering), and design automation. You should have a strong command of **Design for X (DfX)** principles, including Design for Manufacturing, Quality, Circularity, and Cost.

* **Technical Proficiency:** Deep expertise in leading 3D CAD software (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks) and a strong command of PLM processes and tools (particularly Teamcenter). Your experience must include demonstrated proficiency in core HVAC or similar mechanical domains, including structural design, refrigeration system components, sheet metal fabrication, and complex piping and tubing layouts.

* **Advanced Methodologies:** A solid understanding of integrating advanced capabilities into the design process, such as Model-Based Definition (MBD) and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), to automate workflows and reduce rework.
* **Innovative Mindset:** A passion for staying current with emerging technology trends, including AI-driven generative design, design for additive manufacturing, AR collaboration, and IoT-driven design.
* **Strategic Contribution:** The ability to help shape the future of engineering design by experimenting with new technologies and contributing to the strategic roadmap.
* **Exceptional Communication:** Superb written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and effectively.

  

**Career Break:**

  

We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

Nous offrons une rémunération compétitive ainsi que des avantages et des programmes complets. Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances ; tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d’orientation sexuelle, d’identité de genre, d’origine nationale, de grossesse, d’âge, de statut marital, de handicap, de statut de vétéran protégé ou de tout autre statut protégé par la loi.
